Functional requirement: The system shall connect to the site's IP cameras and display their live video.
Notes: Six cameras running concurrently

Functional requirement: The system shall display an annotated view showing detected people and monitored areas, rather than the raw camera picture.
Notes: Operator can switch individual overlays on and off

Functional requirement: The system shall reconnect automatically when a camera connection drops, without operator intervention.
The system shall show the live status of every camera as online, degraded, reconnecting or offline.
Notes: Degraded means pictures are arriving but frozen or slow

Functional requirement: The system shall allow an operator to add or remove a camera without technical assistance.
Notes: Camera is added by entering its address; monitoring starts automatically

Functional requirement: The system shall capture a still image from each camera for use during setup and for attaching to alerts.
The system shall detect people in each camera view and disregard other objects.
Notes: Whether every box is on a real person cannot be confirmed automatically. Furniture is occasionally detected on low-quality camera streams

Functional requirement: The system shall follow each person as they move within a camera view, keeping the same identity through brief obstruction.
Notes: Identity swaps when two people cross need visual confirmation

Functional requirement: The system shall allow detection sensitivity to be tuned per site without software changes.
Notes: Measured guidance recorded: picture quality affects accuracy far more than sensitivity settings

Functional requirement: The system shall allow an operator to define monitored areas by drawing them directly on the camera image.
Notes: No configuration files or technical knowledge required

Functional requirement: The system shall allow each monitored area to carry a name, a maximum capacity and a floor size.
Notes: Floor size is what makes density reporting possible

Functional requirement: The system shall determine which area a person occupies based on where they are standing.
Notes: A seated person may not register, because the reference point is where their feet would be. See FR-16 notes

Functional requirement: The system shall allow an area to be marked as restricted, meaning nobody should be inside it.
Notes: Drives the intrusion alert, FR-26

Functional requirement: The system shall allow an area to be excluded from monitoring, so reflections, screens, posters and neighbouring premises are not counted as people.
Notes: Added after a person reflected in a television was counted

Functional requirement: The system shall not count a person repeatedly when they linger on the boundary of an area.
The system shall report how many people are currently in each monitored area.
Notes: Never checked against a manual head count. A seated person may not be counted if the drawn area does not cover where they are seated

Functional requirement: The system shall report crowd density for each area as people per square metre.
Notes: Approximate. Exact density needs a camera calibration exercise that is not included - see FR-55

Functional requirement: The system shall report how full each area is against its stated capacity.
The system shall report how long people have remained in an area.
Notes: Drives the loitering alert, FR-27

Functional requirement: The system shall report the rate at which people enter and leave each area.
Notes: Reported per minute, with five and fifteen minute trends

Functional requirement: The system shall report a single occupancy figure for the site.
Notes: Counts people standing in monitored areas. Reports plainly that occupancy cannot be counted when no areas have been drawn, rather than showing zero

Functional requirement: The system shall report movement of people between monitored areas.
The system shall raise a warning when crowd density in an area exceeds the warning level.
Notes: Warning level is configurable per area

Functional requirement: The system shall raise a critical alert when crowd density in an area exceeds the critical level.
The system shall raise an alert when an area reaches or exceeds ninety per cent of its capacity.
Notes: Intended to support a decision to restrict entry

Functional requirement: The system shall raise an immediate alert when a person enters a restricted area.
Notes: No delay applied, unlike the density alerts

Functional requirement: The system shall raise an alert when a person remains in an area longer than the permitted time.
Notes: Observed live during testing

Functional requirement: The system shall raise an alert when a camera stops reporting for more than thirty seconds, and clear it when the camera recovers.
The system shall not raise repeated alerts while a condition persists or fluctuates around a threshold.
Notes: A condition crossing back and forth produces one alert, not many

Functional requirement: The system shall allow an operator to acknowledge an alert, recording who acknowledged it and when.
The system shall allow an operator to resolve or dismiss an alert, with an optional note.
The system shall attach an image of the moment to critical density alerts and restricted-area intrusions.
Notes: Not attached to lower-severity alerts

Functional requirement: The system shall present live camera views, area occupancy and active alerts on a single screen.
The system shall update the displayed figures continuously without the operator refreshing the page.
Notes: Measured delay under one second

Functional requirement: The system shall continue displaying current information if the live connection is interrupted.
Notes: Falls back automatically and recovers on its own

Functional requirement: The system shall show a recent occupancy trend for each monitored area.
The system shall distinguish normal, warning and critical conditions clearly on a wall-mounted screen.
Notes: Normal is deliberately uncoloured so warnings carry the urgency

Functional requirement: The system shall produce an occupancy report on demand.
The system shall produce occupancy reports on a schedule.
The system shall allow past events and alerts to be searched by date range, camera and area.
The system shall allow reported figures to be exported for use outside the system.
Notes: Available in spreadsheet-readable and machine-readable form

Functional requirement: The system shall monitor several cameras at the same time.
Notes: Originally excluded from scope; added on request

Functional requirement: The system shall recognise the same person appearing on more than one camera.
Notes: Originally excluded from scope; added on request. Never measured against real footage of the same people on two cameras. Do not rely on this figure for decisions yet

Functional requirement: The system shall avoid counting one person twice when two cameras can see them at the same time.
Notes: Depends on the site layout being recorded correctly. Overlapping camera pairs must be identified during setup

Functional requirement: The system shall not store personally identifying information about any individual.
The system shall refer to individuals only by an anonymous reference that cannot be traced back to a person.
Notes: The reference is regenerated whenever the system restarts, so it cannot be used to follow someone across days

Functional requirement: The system shall not retain the appearance data used to recognise people across cameras.
Notes: Held in memory only, discarded after a set period, never written to disk or logs

Functional requirement: The system shall allow an authorised third-party system to read live occupancy, alerts and camera status.
Notes: Documented for the integrating developer

Functional requirement: The system shall send events, alerts and occupancy figures to the client's platform automatically.
Notes: Continues from where it left off after an interruption rather than losing data

Functional requirement: The system shall restrict access to authorised users and systems only.
Notes: Access requires a credential which can be changed or withdrawn

Functional requirement: The system shall allow an integrated platform to acknowledge alerts on the operator's behalf.
Automatic detection of bottlenecks where people enter faster than they leave.
Notes: Excluded from agreed scope

Functional requirement: Floor-plan heat map showing where crowding occurs.
Notes: Excluded from agreed scope

Functional requirement: Flow diagram showing movement between areas.
Notes: Excluded from agreed scope. The underlying movement figures are available - see FR-22

Functional requirement: Camera calibration to produce exact rather than approximate density.
Notes: Excluded from agreed scope. Requires a site survey. Density remains indicative - see FR-17

Functional requirement: Saving video clips of incidents for later review.
Notes: Excluded from agreed scope. Still images are attached to critical alerts - see FR-32
